claim: The manufacturer says to read the manual before using the piezo controller, because incorrect use can cause injury or damage, and to switch it off and remove the mains plug whenever it is not in use.
validity_conditions: Read from NPC-D Series Digital Controller Interface Library manual, revision 6.0, for DLL 2.7.9 (sha256 88da6849...): printed page 2 (PDF page 2). Also NanoFlash Reflash Application User Manual (sha256 98fbdbf6...): printed page 2 (PDF page 2). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
